commands:
TMP=$(mktemp -d); cat > "$TMP/check.swift" <<'SWIFT'
import Foundation
import Speech
print("speech_auth=\(SFSpeechRecognizer.authorizationStatus().rawValue)")
print("recognizer_pl=\(SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: Locale(identifier: "pl-PL")) != nil)")
print("recognizer_en=\(SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: Locale(identifier: "en-US")) != nil)")
SWIFT
swift "$TMP/check.swift"; rm -rf "$TMP"
